services.name: Yarberry Campground
services.desc: Yarberry Peninsula Campground offers many amenities and is conveniently located in Loudoun County, which is referred to as “The Lakeway to the Smokies”. As the name would suggest, Yarberry is located on the shores of Fort Loudoun Lake, providing stunning views from just about every site. Our large, level sites accommodate the largest RVs and are also perfect for tents. All sites have 50/30 amp service and water. The two spotless bath houses are air conditioned and heated for year-round comfort. We offer a “Honey Wagon” service in addition to the easily accessible dump station. services.name: RV Rental
services.desc: There are a total of 4 Destination RV’s at Barton Springs Campground. RV #3 & #4 sleep 6, RV #1 & #2 sleep 4 and have a bath (RV #2 has one and 1/2 baths). All four RVs have stocked kitchens (dishes, pots & pans), full size refrigerators with ice maker, and have a stove and oven. #1 and 4 have a loft with 2 twin pads.

blurb: Fooshee Pass Campground is located on Watts Bar Lake. It is a great place to camp and relax, or enjoy the many recreational activities on the lake. Many campers enjoy taking their boat out and skiing, fishing, or just enjoying the lake and the mountains.
